title: One early worker bootstrap broker; local candidate evidence
status: local candidate; not production performance evidence
scope: Fresh repository TaskVM only; the selected Mikka worker resource is attested before a credential-free parked broker can accept one committed handoff.
order: early Start and exact release/resource attestation
unchanged fresh credential transaction and COMMIT
single length/hash/identity manifest through existing input stream
original publication, user wake or detached legacy start, matching registration receipt

transport.measurement: Actual installed SDK HTTP serialization against a loopback fixture; identical synthetic task identity and four uploaded files.
includes: actual SDK framed JSON and multipart request body
HTTP response headers and response body
transport.interpretation: Three normal requests remain. A later new command connection is moved earlier, not eliminated from the complete task. The legacy rolling path costs additional bytes. No production speedup is asserted.

lifecycle.abort: Ordered abort is sent over an independently owned input stream. send() only queues; close() supplies the StreamInput acknowledgement. A lost result stream is not process-exit evidence.
lifecycle.uncertainty: After commit, a broken input stream is reported as unconfirmed cancellation; the code does not kill only the broker parent and orphan publication children. The bounded broker and original failed-start TaskVM recovery retain custody. Remote upload/commit outcome races cannot be declared cleaned merely from a client rejection.
lifecycle.staging: Known exited brokers are rejected locally before upload. A successful multipart ACK is required before commit. Partial or unknown upload never grants execution; original failed-start VM recovery remains responsible for uncertain remote residue.
